title: Digital Communications
objectives:
An introduction to digital communication systems and techniques. Description baseband and
carrier-modulated digital transmission, signal detection in noise, inter-symbol interference and
equalization, channel capacity, data compression techniques, error detection and correction
methods. Through lecture students are provided learning experiences that enable them to:
- Identify the baseband modulation schemes for transmission of digital data.
- Address the detection of transmission symbols in the presence of additive white Gaussian noise
- Consider signal design and equalization schemes to combat the effect of inter-symbol
interference (ISI)
- Utilize the concepts of information content of a source and capacity of a communication
channel.
textbooks:
1. J. G. Proakis, M. Saleh, "Digital Communication", 5th Edition, 2008.
2. K. S. Shanmugam, "Digital and Analog Communication Systems", 1978
